name: Stockholm Skavsta Airport
before:
Sold as a Stockholm airport and 100 km from it, which is the first thing to tell a client. Skavsta is in Nyköping Municipality, 5 km from Nyköping itself, and although it carries the Stockholm STO code it is well outside Stockholm County. Arlanda is the city's main airport.

The transfer is the whole question. Flygbussarna coaches run directly to Cityterminalen in central Stockholm, timed to the flights, and take about ninety minutes. There are also airport buses to Södertälje, Linköping and Norrköping, and local buses into Nyköping and to its railway station 7 km away, from which Mälartåg regional trains run on the Norrköping to Stockholm line.

That should change. The Ostlänken high speed line is planned to include a station at the airport, due by 2035, which would cut the journey from Stockholm Central to 52 minutes.

The airport is Sweden's seventh busiest with 364,603 passengers in 2024, mostly low cost carriers and freight, and was designated an official contingency airport in 2023.
after:
Sold as a Stockholm airport and about 100 km from it, which is the first thing to tell a client. Skavsta is in Nyköping Municipality, about 7 km from Nyköping itself, and it lies well outside Stockholm County. Arlanda is the city's main airport.

The transfer is the whole question. Flygbussarna coaches run to Cityterminalen in central Stockholm, and others to Norrköping and Linköping. Local buses run into Nyköping by way of its railway station, 7 km away.

That should change. The Ostlänken rail line, due to be finished in 2035, is planned to include a station beside the terminal.

On Eurostat's figures it was Sweden's sixth busiest airport in 2025, with about 340,000 passengers, mostly on low-cost airlines. The government made it an official contingency airport from 2023.
